description: This file defines the ContainedRangeMap class, which implements a hierarchically-organized range map data structure with methods for storing, retrieving, and clearing address ranges. It includes class templates, private data members, and detailed comments explaining the data structure and its guarantees.

classes.name: ContainedRangeMap
classes.description: A template class implementing a hierarchical range map that allows objects to contain other objects, with methods for storing and retrieving address ranges.

methods.name: StoreRange
methods.description: Inserts a range into the map, maintaining hierarchy and ensuring no violations of containment rules.

methods.name: RetrieveRange
methods.description: Retrieves the most specific (smallest) range containing a given address.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Removes all child ranges, resetting the map to an empty state.
